Details 
 Wrangler phone wallet crossbody with coin pouch. Excellent everyday wallet and the perfect vacation wallet.
 Made of PU leather (distressed), this  phone crossbody wallet has:
- Wrangler logo applique on the front
- A front zippered pocket 
-  2 main pockets and each with 2 inner compartments and total 8 card slots and 1 ID window
- A detachable round coin purse with 'W" logo
- Adjustable and detachable Wrangler shoulder strap
- Phone wallet bag measures: 4.3"(L) x 2.4" (W) x 7.1"(H). Front Pocket: 4.3"(L) x 0.8" (W)x 4.9"(H). Coin Pocket: 4"(L) x 1"(W) x 3.7"(H). Adjustable Strap Drop: 15.7"-26". 
- Color: Blue Jean
